info.name: Atlassian Admin Account Issue Type Screen Schemes API
Atlassian Get Issue Type Screen Scheme Items

params.name: startAt
params.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).

params.name: maxResults
params.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

params.name: issueTypeScreenSchemeId
params.description: The list of issue type screen scheme IDs. To include multiple issue type screen schemes, separate IDs with ampersand: `issueTypeScreenSchemeId=10000&issueTypeScreenSchemeId=10001`.

items.docs:
Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of issue type screen scheme items.

Only issue type screen schemes used in classic projects are returned.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

info.name: Atlassian Get Issue Type Screen Schemes For Projects

params.name: startAt
params.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).

params.name: maxResults
params.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The list of project IDs. To include multiple projects, separate IDs with ampersand: `projectId=10000&projectId=10001`.

items.docs:
Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of issue type screen schemes and, for each issue type screen scheme, a list of the projects that use it.

Only issue type screen schemes used in classic projects are returned.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

info.name: Atlassian Assign Issue Type Screen Scheme To Project

items.docs:
Assigns an issue type screen scheme to a project.

Issue type screen schemes can only be assigned to classic projects.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

info.name: Atlassian Update Issue Type Screen Scheme

params.name: issueTypeScreenSchemeId
params.description: The ID of the issue type screen scheme.

items.docs:
Updates an issue type screen scheme.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

info.name: Atlassian Delete Issue Type Screen Scheme

params.name: issueTypeScreenSchemeId
params.description: The ID of the issue type screen scheme.

items.docs:
Deletes an issue type screen scheme.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

info.name: Atlassian Append Mappings To Issue Type Screen Scheme

params.name: issueTypeScreenSchemeId
params.description: The ID of the issue type screen scheme.

items.docs:
Appends issue type to screen scheme mappings to an issue type screen scheme.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

info.name: Atlassian Update Issue Type Screen Scheme Default Screen Scheme

params.name: issueTypeScreenSchemeId
params.description: The ID of the issue type screen scheme.

items.docs:
Updates the default screen scheme of an issue type screen scheme. The default screen scheme is used for all unmapped issue types.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

info.name: Atlassian Remove Mappings From Issue Type Screen Scheme

params.name: issueTypeScreenSchemeId
params.description: The ID of the issue type screen scheme.

items.docs:
Removes issue type to screen scheme mappings from an issue type screen scheme.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

info.name: Atlassian Get Issue Type Screen Scheme Projects

params.name: issueTypeScreenSchemeId
params.description: The ID of the issue type screen scheme.

params.name: startAt
params.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).

params.name: maxResults
params.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

items.docs:
Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of projects associated with an issue type screen scheme.

Only company-managed projects associated with an issue type screen scheme are returned.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

info.name: Atlassian Get Issue Type Screen Schemes

params.name: startAt
params.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).

params.name: maxResults
params.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

params.name: id
params.description: The list of issue type screen scheme IDs. To include multiple IDs, provide an ampersand-separated list. For example, `id=10000&id=10001`.

params.name: queryString
params.description: String used to perform a case-insensitive partial match with issue type screen scheme name.

params.name: orderBy
params.description:
[Order](#ordering) the results by a field:

 *  `name` Sorts by issue type screen scheme name.
 *  `id` Sorts by issue type screen scheme ID.

params.name: expand
params.description: Use [expand](#expansion) to include additional information in the response. This parameter accepts `projects` that, for each issue type screen schemes, returns information about the projects the issue type screen scheme is assigned to.

items.docs:
Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of issue type screen schemes.

Only issue type screen schemes used in classic projects are returned.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

info.name: Atlassian Create Issue Type Screen Scheme

items.docs:
Creates an issue type screen scheme.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).
